preconditions.description: The input string s must have a length between 5 and 10,000 characters.
All characters in the input string s must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the number of distinct suffixes followed by the suffixes in lexicographical order.
The number of distinct suffixes k must match the count of unique suffixes found.

postconditions.expression: all(len(suffix) in {2, 3} for suffix in suffixes)
postconditions.description: All suffixes must have a length of either 2 or 3 characters.
